name: Oakhaven Valley
description: A peaceful valley centered around the village of Oakhaven. Rolling hills, dense forests, and the Whispering Caves to the north.

name: Ashfall Wastelands
description: A volcanic wasteland in the east. The air is thick with ash and danger, but rare minerals can be found here.

name: Frostveil Peaks
description: Snow-capped mountains in the far north. Home to isolated clans and ancient ruins.
